name: Vixnix
description: Vixnix was a small terrestrial planet located in the Vixnix system in the Rago sector of the Mid Rim in grid square I-7 on the Standard Galactic Grid, on the edge of Wild Space, The Stinky Jawa Cantina was a cantina located on Vixnix.
